name: Aoyama Shuichi
source: Shuichi is a new addition to the eel restaurant, making him Akane and Atsunori's kouhai. He decided to work part time for the first time in his life, as he wanted to have more experiences before school starts again. Shuichi is an interior design student at a specialist college. He's cheerful, outgoing and polite, but is sometimes hard to read. Shuichi is quite sharp, and picks up on his surroundings with little effort. He apparently went to the same high school as Akane, but she doesn't remember.
